paper.title: Opinion dynamics and bounded confidence: models, analysis and simulation
paper.journal: Journal of Artificial Societies and Social Simulation (JASSS) 5(3)

headline: Hegselmann-Krause 2002 (agent-based): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; consensus fraction at eps=0.3 = 1.00, mean #clusters at eps=0.05 = 8.25

verdicts.gate: P1 consensus above confidence threshold (eps>=0.25 -> 1 cluster in >=90% of runs)
P2 mean #clusters non-increasing across the eps grid
P3 fragmentation at low eps (eps<=0.1 -> mean #clusters >= 2.0)

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the consensus/fragmentation result and would catch an artifact. DISTINCT from Deffuant: HK is synchronous all-neighbours-average, not pairwise.

citations: Hegselmann, R. & Krause, U. (2002). Opinion dynamics and bounded confidence: models, analysis and simulation. Journal of Artificial Societies and Social Simulation (JASSS) 5(3). Open: https://www.jasss.org/5/3/2.html

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction
